body:
incident-bot: PAGE: anomalous auth traffic from 3 IPs hitting edge-proxy (high 401s + partial tokens). alert_id=ALRT-20260308-79 link=https://alerts.redwood.local/alerts/ALRT-20260308-79 :rotating_light:

incident-bot: summary: logs show repeated requests containing what look like truncated bearer tokens and a few `x-debug-token` snippets. Potentially leaked debug archive. Marked as P1 due to possible credential exposure.

DANA: oncall here, seen the alert. pulling logs now. which customer names are in the traces?

SARAH: looks like staging traffic forwarded to a third-party log bucket included a handful of auth headers. low-volume but repeated. suspect a CI job shipped dev creds in a debug dump.

MIKE: disabling log forwarder for staging now (will keep local copies). running:```bash
kubectl -n observability scale deployment log-forwarder --replicas=0
```

DANA: ack. blocking src IPs at edge (temporary). `edge-fw block 45.33.12.0/24 2h`

LEE: starting a targeted credential rotation for the affected service account(s). list from quick grep: `svc-telemetry-staging`, `ci-runner-alpha`. will coordinate with infra.

KATIE: tagging legal for potential customer notification. @legal please advise on thresholds for disclosure.

LEGAL: we need scope: which customers had identifiable PII or full tokens? If just truncated tokens in logs, we may do internal notice + targeted outreach. keep me posted on rotation timeline.

SARAH: initial grep results: 14 hits with full `Authorization: Bearer` lines in archived logs from 2026-03-07T02:10 - 02:45 UTC. Two distinct full tokens found; the rest are partial. implicated buckets: s3://redwood-staging-logs-2026 and s3://ci-debug-dumps.

DANA: timeline: disable forwarder @3245671300, block IPs @3245671400, start rotations @3245671500. tagging responders: @sarah @mike @lee.

MIKE: rotating keys now for `ci-runner-alpha` and `svc-telemetry-staging`. commands I'm running:```bash
# rotate service account key
redwoodctl iam key rotate --service-account=ci-runner-alpha --region=us-west-2
# invalidate old tokens in auth-db
authctl sessions invalidate --filter "client_id:ci-runner-alpha" --reason "suspected leakage"
```

SARAH: copying relevant log objects for forensics into locked bucket `s3://incident-evidence/3245671234/` and restricting ACLs. then we'll scrub sensitive lines and run regex to assert no other exposures.

KATIE: customer-impact assessment: telemetry indicates only internal staging projects touched. no production customer apps showing 5xx or auth errors. still, two external IPs scanned endpoints; may be attempt at token replay. recommend precautionary email to partners with staging access.

LEGAL: proceed with partner notice draft. keep wording narrow: describe what we know and steps taken. avoid speculating about customer data access until forensic complete.

LEE: rotation complete for ci-runner-alpha and svc-telemetry-staging. new keys provisioned and deployed at 3245671800. old keys revoked and removed from secrets manager.

DANA: doing a sweep for similar patterns across last 7 days: running `grep -R "Authorization: Bearer" /var/log/* | grep -E "(staging|ci)"`. will report hits.

SARAH: forensic note: attacker replay attempts hit a non-production endpoint and were rate-limited; no successful data exfil recorded. copies stored in evidence bucket.

MIKE: re-enabled log-forwarder in read-only mode with scrub filter and no external sink after scrub test passes. command:```bash
kubectl -n observability set env deployment/log-forwarder SCRUB_PATTERNS="Authorization|x-debug-token" && kubectl -n observability scale deployment log-forwarder --replicas=2
```

KATIE: draft customer/partner notice ready for legal review. will post to #incidents-customer-notify once approved.

LEGAL: reviewed, minor edits. approve for targeted partner emails.

DANA: summarizing actions: 1) forwarder paused 2) IPs blocked 3) keys rotated for 2 svc accounts 4) evidence copied + ACL locked 5) log-forwarder re-enabled with scrub filters 6) partner notice drafted. moving to post-incident review.

SARAH: follow-ups: add automated rule to deny log-forwarder sinks that include Authorization headers; add CI lint rule to fail builds that include `Authorization` in artifacts. filing follow-ups in GH: `infra/issue-4567` and `devex/issue-122`.

MIKE: leaving a runbook note under `incidents/2026-03-auth-log-scrub` with commands and timestamps.

DANA: thanks all. closing pager but keeping channel open for any late findings. :white_check_mark:
